prompt: In the style of a cinematic film still, the interior of a bustling fire station bay is captured in sharp detail. On the left side of the frame, a tall firefighter in a yellow helmet stands with arms crossed. Next to him, a shiny red fire truck dominates the space, its chrome bumper gleaming under the overhead lights. A small brown dog sits calmly on the polished concrete floor near the front tire of the truck. The dog looks up at a mechanic in blue overalls who is kneeling beside the vehicle. The mechanic holds a silver wrench in his right hand, tightening a bolt on the wheel. In the center of the room, a wooden table is cluttered with various items. A steaming white coffee mug rests on the edge of the table. Beside the mug, a folded newspaper lies open to the sports section. A woman in a green apron stands behind the table, wiping it with a gray cloth. She is looking at a child in a striped shirt who is reaching for a toy fire engine. The toy fire engine is bright yellow and plastic. The child sits on a sturdy wooden chair pulled up to the table. To the right of the table, an older man in a gray sweater leans against a metal locker. He is holding a black smartphone in his left hand. Next to the older man, a young cadet in a navy uniform adjusts his tie while looking into a small mirror attached to the locker door. Hanging on the wall above them is a large brass bell. Below the bell, a coiled orange hose hangs neatly on a rack. A black boot rests on the bottom shelf of the locker. Near the back wall, a large clock shows the time as noon. A calendar hangs next to the clock, displaying the month of October. A potted fern sits on a high shelf in the background, adding a touch of green. There is no smoke visible in the air. There is no fire burning anywhere in the scene. There is no water spraying from any hoses. The scene is static yet filled with potential energy, each element distinct and clearly defined within the busy environment.
